profile.headline: Software Developer at SingleStore | Author | Python Enthusiast
profile.summary:
My passion is discovering creative ways of combining technologies that don't appear, at first glance, to be related. Once I'm determined to solve a difficult problem, I don't give up until I find a solution that not only works correctly, but also feels right.

Technical skills include coding in Python, C, Go, shell scripts, Javascript, HTML / CSS, and LaTeX / TeX. Other skills include authoring books and conference papers, as well as significant experience in public speaking.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
▮ Worked with a small team to create a cloud-based Apache Iceberg export service from SingleStoreDB.
▮ Developed a complete Python ecosystem for working with SingleStoreDB using the Python DB-API, SQLAlchemy, and as a DataFrame using the Ibis framework.
▮ Created the fastest Python MySQL client by extending the PyMySQL pure Python client with a C extension. The C extension reduced runtime by up to 90% by implementing the MySQL packet parsing completely in C.
▮ Created the first WASI Python reactor builds for running Python in SingleStoreDB using WASM, including WASIX, a POSIX compatibility layer between WASI and POSIX-based C libraries.

positions.title: Distinguished Software Developer
positions.description:
▮ Developed a Go client for SAS Viya for use in micro services.
▮ Created continuous delivery processes for Python and R Viya clients including packaging, unit and install testing, and publishing to multiple repositories (Anaconda Cloud, PyPI, and GitHub releases).
▮ Improved performance of Viya scripting clients by as much as 50% in some instances.
▮ Researched ways of consolidating code across all Viya clients utilizing features of the Go toolset and features. 
▮ Created Python client for SAS Event Stream Processing (ESP) using REST and WebSockets. This included implementing streaming chart and DataFrame support in Jupyter notebooks.

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
▮ Created a framework for SAS Viya clients which supports multiple scripting languages. Languages included Python, R, Lua, Matlab, Octave, Perl, PHP, Julia, NodeJS all utilizing a shared C library backend through compiled extensions or foreign function interfaces (FFI).
▮ Integrated Python and R Viya clients into Jupyter and Apache Zeppelin notebooks.
▮ Created a build process for compiling Python and R extensions across platforms while using a proprietary SAS standard library.
▮ Authored internal and external documentation for Viya scripting clients. This included topics from getting started examples to detailed API documents.
▮ Code reviewed Jupyter notebooks authored by other employees to ensure consistency.
▮ Authored two books on Python and R Viya client interfaces.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
▮ Implemented a CSS engine in the SAS Output Delivery System (ODS) which worked across all ODS destinations such as HTML, PDF, RTF, and Excel.
▮ Authored two books covering various facets of ODS.
▮ Presented numerous conference papers at local, regional, and national SAS conferences.

projects.title: SingleStoreDB Python Client
projects.description: This project is a client for connecting to SingleStoreDB. It is a modified version of PyMySQL (a pure Python MySQL connector) which includes a C extension that reduces data conversion time by up to 90%. The package also includes features for managing clusters and workspaces in the SingleStore managed service.

projects.title: WASIX
projects.description: POSIX compatibility layer for WASI projects. This library was initially used to build a WASI version of Python including various C extension modules. It has also been used in porting other languages and libraries to WASI by SingleStore and other companies.

patents.title: Computer-implemented System and Method for Generating Data Graphical Displays
patents.description: A computer-implemented system and method for generating data graphical displays. The data is indicative of a plurality of variables. The system and method receive data that is to be displayed in a non-textual format. Graph style data items are retrieved that contain display characteristics for displaying the data in the non-textual format. The data is displayed in accordance with the graph style data items.
